description: BigQuery SQL: run a read-only SQL query, including against Google's public datasets (Wikipedia, GitHub, blockchains, weather, census and more), and get columns and rows back as JSON with the bytes processed. Every query is dry-run first and refused above the scan ceiling, so cost is bounded before it runs. Input: sql; optional max_scan_gib. Ask in plain English instead: data.question. $0.50 per call. Returns: columns[], rows[], row_count, gib_processed, cache_hit.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

name: hubvibe_data_query
title: Run a BigQuery query
